verdicts.reason: A stretches the original strip vertically: the headline and subhead are pushed about 70px apart so the subhead floats as an orphan near the bottom, the CTA and NEW badge hang mid-right with no shared baseline, and the small headline leaves big dead bands. B regroups everything into one stacked block (badge, headline, subhead, CTA) with a sensible reading order, but the left edges don't line up (badge, headline and button each start at a different x), the button sits too far below the copy, and the whole block is pushed left of centre, leaving the right half of the canvas empty.
